name: velero-backup-verification-failures
description: Failures from velero backup-verification CronJob in velero namespace.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="velero" AND resource.labels.pod_name=~"^backup-verification-" AND (severity>=ERROR OR textPayload:"FAIL" OR textPayload:"FAILED" OR textPayload:"ERROR" OR textPayload:"Back-off")
